verdict.rationale: GlitchTip records incoming errors as issues (glitchtip-docs-28), and its release notes cite 'issue fingerprint grouping' (glitchtip-docs-55) and 'Merge issue support' (glitchtip-docs-53). Merging is a way to fix grouping when it goes wrong, but the evidence consists of headline-level mentions with no explanation of how the grouping works or how to customize it. missing for 10: documentation of stack-trace-based default grouping behavior, documented custom fingerprint or grouping-rule configuration, details on how merging works, independent or hands-on corroboration that duplicates collapse reliably at scale.
